name: Hobi Journeys
description: Hobi Journeys is a corporate incentive travel agency WordPress theme designed for agencies planning reward trips, team summits, and sales retreats for groups of 20 to 120 guests. Built with a results-first case wall, transparent pricing tables, and structured planning workflows, it communicates corporate travel with operational clarity. Featuring calm documentary photography styling and clean sans typography, the theme works seamlessly with or without WooCommerce.
